chunks: They did not restrain one another from the wicked things they used to do; and vile were the things that they were doing!

key_terms.يَتَنَاهَوْنَ: They restrain or check one another

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people do not restrain one another from evil?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the failure of the Banu Israel to practice *Amr bil Ma'ruf wa Nahi anil Munkar* (Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil) within their own community, leading to collective moral decay. Their neglect of mutual accountability is cited as a primary reason for divine punishment, emphasizing that communal responsibility is a prerequisite for maintaining spiritual integrity.
